Markets.title: US stocks: US market rebounds to close higher as surging Treasury yields recede
Markets.summary: US stocks closed higher as the S&P 500 recovered from a global bond selloff following receding Treasury yields. The market gains were further supported by a solid labor market report and strong technology shares led by Accenture.

Markets.title: Fed’s Jefferson urges patience on rates; Kashkari sees more hikes ahead
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated there is no immediate need for further interest rate changes. Meanwhile, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari expressed uncertainty about the timing of potential future rate hikes due to strong economic performance.

Markets.title: Why are world bond markets selling off again?
Markets.summary: Government borrowing costs have surged to their highest levels since 2002 due to rising inflation fears and mounting debt pressures. These increasing bond yields are raising loan costs for families and businesses while straining government finances.

Markets.title: Global markets rattled as bond yields surge, offsetting AI-stock optimism
Markets.summary: Global stock indexes declined as surging bond yields overshadowed optimism in technology stocks like Micron Technology. Meanwhile, rising oil prices and a 10-year Treasury yield near a 2002 high heightened economic and real-estate concerns despite overall US resilience.

Markets.title: Adani Group has Rs 2.6 lakh crore projects completed or under execution in Maharashtra: Pranav Adani
Markets.summary: The Adani Group has completed or is currently executing projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore in Maharashtra. Its total investment blueprint in the state exceeds Rs 6 lakh crore across sectors such as energy, infrastructure, and urban redevelopment.

Markets.title: US stocks: US markets dip as surging Treasury yields overshadow software gains
Markets.summary: US stocks dipped as rising Treasury yields weakened investor confidence, overshadowing gains in the software sector. While September brought monthly losses for the S&P 500 and Dow, the Nasdaq grew due to artificial intelligence optimism.

Geo-Political.title: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injection attempts. Her lawyers are now asking a court to commute her death sentence following the botched execution.

Geo-Political.title: What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike, a convicted killer in Tennessee, was hospitalized after surviving two lethal injection attempts. This failed execution has raised multiple legal and ethical questions about the state's capital punishment procedures.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that the pilot who attempted to hijack a Flydubai plane suffered from Islamist radical indoctrination. Netanyahu added that the pilot clearly intended to crash the aircraft.

Geo-Political.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin warned Western leaders that Russia is prepared to use all available weapons to defend the exclave of Kaliningrad. Despite this threat, Putin claimed that Moscow is not making any threats and is only reacting to recent Western statements.

Geo-Political.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
Geo-Political.summary: The family of Renee Good, a US woman killed by an ICE agent, is suing Trump administration officials in Minneapolis. Lawyers for the family allege that these officials created an unprecedented environment for state-sponsored violence.

Geo-Political.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
Geo-Political.summary: Russian chess grandmaster and dissident Garry Kasparov stated that U.S. officials warned him of a threat to his life from Russia. Kasparov added that neither he nor his family will be truly safe while Vladimir Putin remains in power.

Data & Insights.title: US 10-year yield jumps to 5.34% as global bond rout pushes borrowing costs higher
Data & Insights.summary: Global bond markets suffered heavy selling, driving the US 10-year yield up to 5.34% and pushing borrowing costs to multi-decade highs. Analysts warn that surging inflation and energy costs could trigger further market declines despite temporary stabilization.

Data & Insights.title: AI bubble burst ‘inevitable’, India-US trade ties strained by Lindsey Graham bill, says Finance Ministry report
Data & Insights.summary: India's Finance Ministry reports that trade relations with the US are strained following a bill by Senator Lindsey Graham that proposes up to 100% tariffs on countries purchasing Russian crude oil. The report also warns that this legislation could drive up oil prices and bond yields while slowing capital flows and artificial intelligence investments.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why tax refunds matter for Indian apparel exports
Data & Insights.summary: The RoSCTL tax refund scheme helps Indian apparel exporters offset embedded domestic taxes. This support allows them to compete on price despite rising costs, supply chain disruptions, and rival manufacturing hubs.

Data & Insights.title: 'Sustaining growth will require...': Finance Ministry warns of geopolitical, supply-chain risks; projects 7.3% Q2 growth
Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry projects India's second-quarter fiscal year 2027 GDP growth at 7.3 percent, following a 7.8 percent rate in the first quarter. However, the ministry warns that global risks such as geopolitical tensions, supply-chain disruptions, volatile energy prices, and tighter financial conditions could threaten this economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: India faces ‘stiff’ external challenges, global fight for capital: MoF review
Data & Insights.summary: India's finance ministry reported that the country faces intense external challenges, including US trade tensions and a global competition for capital. Despite these pressures and global manufacturing pushes, India's domestic growth and external buffers remain resilient.

Data & Insights.title: Manufacturing PMI jumps to 7-month high of 55.1 in September on strong demand, hiring
Data & Insights.summary: India's Manufacturing PMI rose to a seven-month high of 55.1 in September, driven by strong demand and increased hiring. However, despite this September rebound, the second-quarter PMI averaged 53.8, which is the lowest Q2 reading since 2021 following a sluggish start to the fiscal year.

India.title: Ram Temple Staff To Undergo 100% Police Verification, Character Checks
India.summary: The trust managing the Ram Temple requires complete background checks and police verification for all staff members. Employees must also provide comprehensive details about their families and relatives.

India.title: Delhi Court Upholds Senior Citizens Rule To Evict Children From Property
India.summary: A Delhi court upheld a legal rule allowing senior citizens to evict their children from property. The court ruled that this authority comes from state government powers designed to protect the property and lives of older adults.

India.title: Bhagwant Mann's Japan Hockey Trip Denied Clearance By Centre
India.summary: The central government denied political clearance for Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann to visit Japan. Mann and a state delegation had been invited by the Asian Hockey Federation to attend the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games.

India.title: Adhir Chowdhury's 'Congress Offer' To Mamata Banerjee With 'Baggage' Rider
India.summary: Congress leader Adhir Chowdhury has offered an alliance to Mamata Banerjee's party amid its current political crisis. However, he attached specific conditions to this offer.

India.title: Firing Outside Senior Punjab Cop's Office, Bullets Hit Building
India.summary: Unknown attackers fired shots outside a senior Punjab police officer's office, damaging the building. Police arrested two suspects with an illegal pistol and are searching for the remaining individuals.

India.title: From 'Bai Sukhbir' to 'Vibe Punjab Di': Akali Dal Takes Gen-Z Outreach Route Ahead of 2027 Punjab Polls
India.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Punjab elections, the Shiromani Akali Dal has launched a Gen-Z outreach campaign titled 'Vibe Punjab Di'. During these events, party leader Sukhbir Badal takes direct questions from students to build a personal connection.

General.title: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford incident, police say
General.summary: A 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in London in connection with an incident near the RAF Fairford airbase. This marks the sixth arrest made by police regarding Sunday's event.
